orders.thesis: Vertiv Q3: sales $4.31B (+61%) vs $3.75B consensus, adj EPS $2.21 vs $1.82, organic orders >100%, FY26 guide raised (sales $14.65B, EPS $7.15). Stock gapped +14% but is still well below its July high (~$339) and post-earnings drift after large beat-and-raise tends to persist. Risks: no 2027 guide, orders disclosure ending, high volatility (4.4% daily).

PAGE DATE: Oct 28, 2026, 17:12 (published date printed on the page)

**Orders:** Q3 organic orders were up more than 100% year over year. CEO Gio Albertazzi said this reflects market strength rather than catch-up demand. Management said it will not disclose orders data going forward. Q3 orders were described as balanced across customer types, with or without Neocloud.

**Backlog:** The page gives no backlog dollar figure and no book-to-bill ratio. The only reference is that management plans to "execute on a robust backlog" while expanding capacity.

**Results:** Revenue was $4.31B, up 61%, aga
